args: const {strict:assert}=require("node:assert");(async()=>{const base="http://127.0.0.1:31889";const req=async(path,init)=>{const r=await fetch(base+path,init);const body=await r.json();assert.equal(r.status,200,path+" status");return body};const before=await req("/__local/state");const update={stream:"trade_updates",data:{event:"partial_fill",execution_id:"execution-smoke",timestamp:"2025-01-02T14:30:01Z",price:"190.25",qty:"2",position_qty:"2",order:{id:"order-smoke",client_order_id:"local-order-smoke",asset_id:"asset-smoke",symbol:"AAPL",side:"buy",type:"limit",status:"partially_filled",order_class:"simple",time_in_force:"day",qty:"4",filled_qty:"2",filled_avg_price:"190.25"}}};const accepted=await req("/__local/trade-updates",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({updates:[update]})});assert.equal(accepted.simulated,true);assert.equal(accepted.mode,"paper");assert.equal(accepted.accepted,1);const observed=await req("/__local/state");assert.equal(observed.tradeUpdates.length,1);assert.equal(observed.tradeUpdates[0].receivedAt,before.now);assert.deepEqual(observed.account.positions,before.account.positions);assert.deepEqual(observed.account.openOrders,before.account.openOrders);const compared=await req("/__local/assert-state",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({expected:{tradeUpdates:observed.tradeUpdates}})});assert.equal(compared.matched,true);const reset=await req("/__local/reset",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:"{}"});assert.equal(reset.tradeUpdates.length,0);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"PASS",simulated:true,mode:"paper",accepted:1,virtualReceiveTime:true,canonicalAccountUnchanged:true,expectedStateMatched:true,resetCleared:true}));})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1)});
